title: dSpCRISPRi Tiling Screen Targeting the TOX Locus in Primary Human CD8+ T Cells
author: Christian McRoberts Amador
materials: Intracellular Staining Buffers and solution preparation Prepare fresh Foxp3 Fixation/Permeabilization (FOXP3 TF staining kit, ThermoFisher) working solution by mixing 1 part of Foxp3 Fixation/Permeabilization Concentrate with 3 parts of Foxp3 Fixation/Permeabilization Diluent. One mL of the working solution is required for each sample, if staining in tubes. Prepare a 1X working solution of Permeabilization Buffer by mixing 1 part of 10X Permeabilization Buffer with 9 parts of distilled water. 8.5 mL of the working solution is required for each sample, if staining in tubes. Experimental Procedure in 12 x 75 mm Tubes Prepare a single-cell suspension. Refer to ‘Cell Preparation Protocols for Flow Cytometry’ [Optional] Stain cells with a Fixable Viability Dye. Refer to ‘Viabilty Dye Staining, Protocol C’ for more details Stain cell surface markers. Refer to ‘Staining Cell Surface Targets, Protocol A’ for details. After the final wash, discard the supernatant and pulse vortex the sample to completely dissociate the pellet. Typically about 100 µL of residual volume remains. Add 1 mL of Foxp3 Fixation/Permeabilization working solution to each tube and pulse vortex Incubate for 30-60 minutes at 2-8°C or room temperature. Protect from light. (Mouse samples can be incubated for up to 18 hours at 2-8°C in the dark). Add 2 mL of 1X Permeabilization Buffer to each tube and centrifuge samples at 400-600 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature. Discard the supernatant. [Optional] Repeat Step 7. Resuspend pellet in residual volume of 1X Permeabilization Buffer. This is typically 100 µL after decanting. [Optional] Block with 2% normal mouse/rat serum by adding 2 µL directly to the cells. Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature. Add 3.5 mL of 1x Perm buffer ( again, this depends on the concentration) . Without washing, add the recommended amount of directly conjugated antibody for detection of intracellular antigen(s) to cells and incubate for at least 30 minutes at room temperature. Protect from light. ( 1:100 dilution for TOX:APC ab, Miltenyi) Add 2 mL of 1X Permeabilization Buffer to each tube and centrifuge samples at 400-600 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature. Discard the supernatant. Repeat Step 13. Resuspend stained cells in an appropriate volume of Flow Cytometry Staining Buffer ( based on concentration ).

steps.title: Design and generate SpCas9 guide library
steps.instruction: Use GuideScan tiling across chr8:58705412‑59219147 to generate a SpCas9 library, filter guides for cutting specificity >0.37, and add 325 non‑targeting guides with matched nucleotide content, yielding a total of 7,377 guides.

steps.title: Calculate required cell number for coverage
steps.instruction: For 100× coverage in PBMCs, compute required cells as 7,377 guides ÷ 0.20 (fraction transduced from titer experiment) × 100 = 3.7 × 10⁶ cells per replicate.

steps.title: Prepare antibody dilutions for staining
steps.instruction: Based on the D10 cell count, resuspend cells to achieve 10 × 10⁶ cells/mL. Dilute antibodies as follows: Thy1.1‑PE 1:300 and TOX‑APC 1:100.

steps.title: Perform surface marker staining
steps.instruction: Carry out the staining workflow for each T‑cell condition, including a negative‑control condition that will not be stained.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the full volume of each T‑cell condition into labeled 50 mL conical tubes; also transfer an unstained negative‑control sample.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 2–5 min to remove beads and transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Count cells using a Countess instrument.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min, then aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 3,500 µL of FACS‑antibody solution (example volume) to obtain ~10 × 10⁶ cells/mL; for the negative control, resuspend directly in FACS buffer.
Incubate samples on a shaker in a cold room (≈4 °C), covered with aluminum foil, for 30 min.
Add 17,500 µL of FACS buffer (5× the antibody volume; use the calculated volume, not the example) to each sample.
Centrifuge again at 300 g for 5 min and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the final pellet in 1,000 µL of FACS buffer (example volume) for downstream analysis.
